title: The Restricted Geometric Langlands Conjecture
exact_target: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, let $X/k$ be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve, and let $G$ be reductive, with $\operatorname{char}(k)$ greater than the Coxeter number of $G$. In the corresponding derived $\ell$-adic setting, prove the canonical equivalence $\operatorname{Shv}_{\operatorname{Nilp}}(\operatorname{Bun}_G)\simeq\operatorname{IndCoh}_{\operatorname{Nilp}}(\operatorname{LocSys}^{\operatorname{restr}}_{\widehat G})$.
